refinements.trigger: Capture research MCP report_declare validation constraints (trace gate, reconcile gate, path policy) to prevent repeated gate failures.
refinements.evidence: The agent spent many turns blocked by report_declare validation errors. Evidence shows: (1) trace gate rejects declare if any terminal claim.transition lacks a subsequent attack.record; (2) reconcile gate requires every numeric literal in REPORT.md to carry a (P#) citation from a landed probe's metric_recompute, and rejects numbers from world_forecast or world_simulate as uncitable; (3) reconcile gate also detects hallucinated numbers that don't match the probe's actual metric_recompute output; (4) path must resolve strictly inside the active run directory. These are durable API contract facts for the ca_rebound project that will prevent the same failure loop in future sessions.
refinements.outcome: Future sessions will write REPORT.md with only probe-citable numbers (qualitative descriptions for world_forecast/world_simulate results), ensure an attack.record follows every terminal transition, and use run-relative paths, avoiding repeated gate-rejection loops.
